column1: # Black/Matrix AD - English script: Chapter 1 / Courreges arrest scene

column2: Well, well! Looks like the troublesome $$奴隷$$ has come back, does he!?
H-Him... Let go of his hand!!
Even we don't want to get rough with someone with black $$羽$$ like us, you know!
Miss!
But... if you insist on not treating your $$奴隷$$ like a $$奴隷$$...
and keep him running loose without even a $$首輪$$ on him...
then he'll have to die, you see!!
After all, from what we've heard, even if you $$猫っ可愛がり$$ your $$奴隷$$ like a $$ペット$$,
dressing him in clothes is taking it too far, isn't it!?
H-He isn't anything like that!!
You're free to form an $$執着心$$ to your own $$奴隷$$, of course!
I see!!
Like a cup you got from someone you didn't care for at first,
but after using it every day, it starts to seem like something nice!!
That's not it!!
Ah!!
$$愛$$, you say!?
That's what's commonly called $$恋$$ in this $$世界$$—a human's misunderstanding during $$発情期$$!
During $$発情期$$, every animal's heart starts pounding, their $$血$$ rushes to their head...
And sometimes they even shout things that make no sense.
Then all the more reason you should just have him the way you want him!!
Don't be ashamed of your $$欲情$$ for your $$奴隷$$!
$$欲情$$ for someone is...
for every animal, a fundamental act that leads to the preservation of the $$種族$$!
After all, saying...
To speak of a delusion called $$愛$$—something that does not exist in $$この世$$—
is one of the $$七つの大罪$$. Don't you know that!?
